description: Implementation of RRC Dual-Connectivity (RRC DU) interface handling, including cell info retrieval, UE management, RRC message processing, and metrics handling within a 5G NR RRC context.

classes.name: rrc_du_impl
classes.description: Class implementing RRC Dual-Connectivity interface, managing cell info, UEs, and RRC messaging.

methods.name: get_cell_info
methods.description: Retrieves cell information for a list of served cells, including timers, PLMN identities, and frequency info.

methods.name: get_ran_area_cells
methods.description: Generates RAN area cells grouped by PLMN IDs.

methods.name: store_cell_info_db
methods.description: Stores cell information into internal database.

methods.name: get_rrc_reject
methods.description: Creates and returns an RRC Rejection message.

methods.name: get_rrc_resume_context
methods.description: Parses RRC resume request from a byte buffer, returning context including resume ID and cause.

methods.name: add_ue
methods.description: Adds a new UE to the RRC DU, including unpacking configuration containers and initializing UE context.

methods.name: remove_ue
methods.description: Removes a UE from the RRC DU, cleaning up associated resources and metrics.
